findings.title: PostgreSQL peak violates frozen v1 criterion; measurement cannot isolate T5
findings.evidence: PostgreSQL memory.peak is 537141248 bytes against 536870912 configured. Snapshot is cumulative; no before/after memory.events, memory.stat, pressure or cgroup identity is in the closed ZIP.
findings.interpretation: A transient overshoot is allowed by Linux memory.max semantics. This is not proof that Docker ignored the limit or that T5 requires more RAM. It also does not establish adequate headroom or absence of memory pressure.
findings.disposition: Keep failed v1 report intact and T5/E4 open. Instrument before choosing a resource or acceptance change; do not silently relax threshold or increase memory.

findings.title: Failure phase remains restart after persistence succeeded
findings.evidence: Source calls validate_events after restart_persistent and source_unchanged become true, without changing phase. job.log only records restart: ValueError.
findings.disposition: Next implementation must distinguish final-validation phase and identify failed resource/criterion with safe structured diagnostics.

kernel_reference.interpretation: memory.max can be temporarily exceeded; memory.peak records the cgroup lifetime unless reset for the reading FD; memory.events max counts approaches to the boundary, not OOM kills.

limits: Primary audited reports, source and digests; it did not query mac24 or recompute private H&M seed/profiles.
Failed-report envelope validation alone does not imply functional or resource success; successful functional fields were separately audited against source and frozen predicates.
Reported State.OOMKilled=false and zero swap peaks do not prove zero historical cgroup OOM events; counters were not captured in the closed report.
The separately declared 45963 memory.events max occurrences are cumulative, with no baseline or T5 attribution; no OOM/oom_kill is declared there.
Replay covers four initial parity cases and four simulation events; it is not exhaustive per-buyer validation, browser acceptance or load/freshness testing.
46.814 seconds covers the whole rehearsal, including seed and restart; it is not request latency. T8 and final test remain pending.
